Lumen Convert — third-party software notices
=============================================

Lumen Convert runs entirely in your browser. These libraries are shipped in this folder, unmodified except that
"//# sourceMappingURL" comments were removed from some minified files. Each library's licence file sits next to it.

Shared with other Lumen Studio apps (loaded by relative URL, not copied, so the site ships them once):
  ../pdf/vendor/pdf-lib.min.js   pdf-lib 1.17.1 (bundles pako) - MIT - (../pdf/vendor/pdf-lib.LICENSE.md)
  ../pdf/vendor/pdfjs/   PDF.js (pdfjs-dist 6.4.299: library, worker, cmaps, standard fonts, ICC profiles, wasm) - Apache-2.0 - (../pdf/vendor/pdfjs/LICENSE)
  ../layout/vendor/fonts/SourceSerif4_*.ttf, Montserrat_*.ttf   SIL Open Font License 1.1   (../layout/vendor/fonts/OFL-*.txt)
      embedded (subset) into PDFs made by DOCX -> PDF, TXT -> PDF and EPUB -> PDF
  ../pdf/js/export.js, security.js, compare.js (+ the modules they import)   Lumen PDF's own code: layout analysis and
      DOCX writer (PDF -> Word / Excel), AES-256 standard security handler (Protect / Unlock), word diff (Compare)
  ../pdf/vendor/fonts/*.woff2   Allura, Caveat, Dancing Script, Great Vibes, Sacramento - OFL 1.1 - typed signatures
  ../photo/vendor/libraw/   LibRaw (LGPL-2.1 or CDDL-1.0; unmodified separate files, libraw-wasm packaging ISC) - RAW -> JPEG/PNG
  ../photo/vendor/ag-psd.js   ag-psd (MIT) - PSD -> PNG/JPEG
  ../pdf/vendor/tesseract/  tesseract.js 7.0.0 + tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 + English "best_int" data   Apache-2.0
      (../pdf/vendor/tesseract/NOTICE.txt) — loaded only when an OCR tool runs

LGPL components (lamejs, libheif) are separate, unmodified, replaceable files that are loaded only when needed
(MP3 encoding; HEIC decoding). Their complete corresponding source is available from the projects:
  lamejs:  https://github.com/breezystack/lamejs  (LAME: https://lame.sourceforge.io/)
  libheif: https://github.com/strukturag/libheif  (packaging: https://github.com/catdad-experiments/libheif-js)

The WAV, FLAC, resampling and time-stretch code in js/tools-media.js is Lumen Studio's own (adapted from Lumen Sound).
